title: Elemental Shrine at Night
prompt: A seamless looping sacred elemental shrine at night, intimate and meditative: shallow water moving slowly over smooth stones, a tiny sheltered fire with soft crackle, occasional ceramic water drops, very distant bronze bowl resonance, and a warm airy shimmer suggesting light. Spacious natural reverb, close detailed texture, no melody, no rhythm, no voices, no birds, no thunder, no dramatic impacts, gentle dynamic range, 30 seconds.
